description: lievit-kit: the "Filament for Spring" admin layer, an in-monorepo module on the lievit runtime (ADR-0008, amended 2026-06-17). Resource + Panel + Form/Table builders (a shared Schema parent from v0.1) + RenderHook extension points + a persistence-agnostic RecordRepository port + a first-class @Page. Path-depends on lievit-core (the SPI) and the starter (the wire runtime); never hard-couples a persistence engine.
